resources.string: No Apple Watch is paired with this iPhone.
Phase Wake on the watch
Install Phase Wake on your Apple Watch in the Watch app.
Alarms allowed
Allow Phase Wake to set alarms so your iPhone can ring as a backup alarm.
Start nightstand mode
For the sunrise, leave Phase Wake open on the charger overnight. The screen stays dark until the light begins.
End
Sunrise at %1$s
No alarm with sunrise
Your iPhone can only show the light while Phase Wake is open – start nightstand mode before you go to sleep.
Sleep duration and regularity come from Apple Health.
Open Phase Wake before you go to sleep so your watch can arm the alarm.
Alarm armed on the watch
Open Phase Wake on your Apple Watch before you go to sleep. watchOS only arms the alarm while the app is open.
First %1$d min not measured – the Apple Watch only measures the last %2$d min before the target.

Apple Health
Nights from Apple Health and other apps can show up here too. To see them, compare with health data.
No sleep data from Apple Health yet. Sleep has to be recorded there, for example by your Apple Watch, and Phase Wake must be allowed to read it in the Health app.
Nights from other apps (e.g. Apple Health) aren’t backed up – they stay there and show up again once access is granted.

Phase Wake can read the sleep data that your health app (for example Apple Health) stores. It is shown in your history and used to check the moment you were woken. Phase Wake only reads, never writes, and nothing leaves your phone.
